population: Every assigned v4 slot; no failures, spikes, pre-intervention differences or unrun slots removed
measurement_admission: Use existing isolated-acquisition analyzer, native replay, exact provenance, lifecycle, original sampling and >=98% coverage EACH required window. Any integrity failure blocks controller performance comparison for this batch.
ordered_questions: First reduced input, driver receipt and first acknowledging publication, aligned to each run's first manifold; retain earlier loaded contacts
Actual wheel/body trajectories and source-stamp uncertainty before every subsequent loaded component contact; earlier commands or targets do not answer this question
Unchanged crossing/post-contact/whole-route slip, vibration, tracking, arrival/stopping and time; original paired/block estimand and sampling sensitivities
actual_response_diagnostics: Reuse offline H2 diagnostic sensitivities 0.01/0.02/0.04 m/s and >=60ms sustained difference, with original candidate source stamps and backward-only reference lookup. Subtract precontact median candidate-minus-reference on -0.3..-0.05s; retain unadjusted baseline and all differences before first input. These are descriptive between-run divergence, never an identified causal onset or a promotion gate.
uncertainty: Keep original paired/block bootstrap descriptive uncertainty; four triads on two blocks are not a generalization test. GT ~50Hz limits timing resolution; do not invent finer measurements by resampling.
application_thresholds: 10% / +0.5s remain proposals; no automatic H2 pass/fail or tuning
stop: At integrity fault or 12 attempts, close batch with no retry/extension. Diagnose a concrete fault offline if present; never rescue a closed run with relaxed gates. No new simulation contract is automatically released.
